english.note: Use this when “principal” specifically stresses being the most important rather than simply the main one.
Use this as the all-purpose rendering when “prime” means highest in importance.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something that is of the highest importance.

examples.english: Ming plays the principal role on the team.
examples.traditional: 阿明喺隊入面擔當最重要嘅角色。

examples.english: This is the company's prime issue.
